name: HeroVideo
description: Piqueray HeroVideo, responsive. 2.3.0 (2026-09-08, MINOR: the two veils re-read on the canvas — a never-promoted drift carried, plus the owner's « plus foncé » decision on the Desktop and Wide bottom scrims; no anchor change, no prop touched). 2.2.0 (2026-09-08, MINOR additif) : le plan Background porte enfin ses attributs de lecture (autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline, preload=metadata) — la surface livree rendait jusqu'ici une video qui ne demarrait nulle part. Le fichier video reste un asset gouverne de l'addon (jamais du contenu de page) ; seule l'affiche est du contenu, choisie par le redacteur comme une image. 2.0.0 (2026-09-02, Odoo hero pilot): re-extracted from the spec-031 set 2689:15832 (page « 031 · Planches de validation »), four `presentation` variants Mobile / Tablette / Desktop / Wide validated by the owner. Everything the canvas draws is proposed by `npm run extract:figma` and adopted as-is: layout per mode (column centered on Mobile/Tablette, row bottom-aligned on Desktop/Wide), paddings / gap / height per mode as tokensByProp on the presentation axis, the title riding the responsive text style H1 (typography.h1.* — size and line-height vary by viewport mode through tokens/modes/viewport.*). Added by hand, each named: the host element (section — not drawn), the CTA pinned to the bottom edge on Mobile/Tablette (drawn ABSOLUTE on the canvas; the dump does not carry layoutPositioning), and the CTA's right icon fixed to TRUE (the canvas shows it on Desktop/Wide only; the schema has no per-mode channel for a nested instance's prop — `propsByProp` was abandoned on 2026-08-20 — so the Odoo projection hides the glyph under the desktop breakpoint, an acknowledged deviation). The drawn widths 390/668/1200/1728 are witnesses, not tokens: the root fills its parent. Code supports a video URL and poster; Figma projects the poster as a static IMAGE placeholder. The two governed scrims belong to HeroVideo itself. Breakpoints are not in this contract: they are the token dimension `breakpoint.*` (768 / 992 / 1600), consumed by the CSS build. Plan de document : la partie titre porte la balise h1 (accessibilite-home-odoo, 2026-09-04) ; l'apparence reste pilotee par les jetons typography, axe independant du niveau.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Viewport presentation, mirroring the canvas axis Presentation. Default = mobile, the first variant of the 031 set (Figma's default) and the mobile-first base of the delivered CSS; in the delivered CSS the mode is selected by the viewport through the breakpoint tokens, never by a consumer.

props.name: backgroundUrl
props.description: Code-side poster source. On canvas, this poster is the deterministic static placeholder for the video.

props.name: videoUrl
props.description: Code-side video source. Figma's native videoHash has no contract-to-code URL transport, so the canvas intentionally uses only the static poster placeholder.

props.name: backgroundAlt
props.description: Alternative text for the decorative poster plane.

props.name: accroche
props.description: HeroVideo title. RICH text (owner rule 2026-09-02: a text drawn with a line break is rich, whether or not the set exposes a TEXT property — the 031 set draws its title on the node, no property; binding NONE). The 031 set breaks after « HÖRMANN »: explicitly on Desktop/Wide (U+2028), naturally on Mobile/Tablette. The break is a governed segment fact; WHERE the editor breaks stays content. No bold. Includes the non-breaking spaces around HÖRMANN.

default.text:
Le numéro 1 des portes HÖRMANN
en Province de Liège !

Background.description: Out-of-flow media reception plane. Code renders video plus poster; Figma renders and preserves only the static poster IMAGE. 2.2.0 (2026-09-08) : les cinq attributs de lecture sont portes ici, mesures sur l'instance jetable pilote. autoplay+muted+playsinline sont indissociables (sans muted le navigateur refuse le demarrage, sans playsinline Safari iOS passe en plein ecran) ; loop parce que c'est un fond ; preload=metadata et NON none : mesure du 2026-09-08, avec none Chrome affiche l'affiche et ne lance jamais la video (readyState 0). Le conseil de perf habituel (preload none) est donc ecarte par la mesure ; c'est l'affiche allegee qui protege le LCP.

VoileBas.description: Bottom scrim PLUS a full-surface plain veil. Re-read on the canvas on 2026-09-08; three facts, all carried verbatim from the set 2689:15832. (1) A DRIFT never promoted: the canvas had gone from 0.80 to 0.88 at the bottom on Mobile/Tablette and from 0.60 to 0.72 on Desktop/Wide. Carried; nothing invented. (2) Owner decision, first pass (option A): Desktop and Wide only, the ramp starts 10 points earlier (50 to 40 % on Desktop, 44 to 34 % on Wide) and the amplitude rises by the factor 0.80/0.72, so the bottom reaches 0.80. Mobile and Tablette were NOT touched: at 0.88 they were already darker than the target. (3) Owner decision, second pass (option D, « pas assez cinematic, les autres elements ne ressortent pas assez »): a SOLID fill bound to color/noir-voile-25 (25 % black) is added UNDER the gradient, on all four variants — the same two-paint structure ds.hero's Voile already had. Under the title on desktop the effective black goes to 0.85. The gradient is a governed literal per mode (literalsByProp on the presentation axis); the plain veil rides the token and needs no registry entry.

VoileNavigation.description: Top veil (navigation readability), RE-READ on the canvas on 2026-09-08: the canvas had drifted from this contract without ever being promoted (Mobile/Tablette 0.65 to 0.7215, Desktop/Wide 0.58 to 0.6786). The drift is carried verbatim; the 2026-09-08 owner decision did NOT touch this veil. NAMED CONSEQUENCE: ds.hero's VoileNavigation still carries 0.65 / 0.58 because ITS master still draws those values — the sentence 'the Hero reuses the HeroVideo top veil' in ds.hero 3.0.0 stopped being true the day the HeroVideo master drifted. Each contract carries what its own master draws. literalsByProp on the presentation axis.

Text.description: Title column. FILL width; grows to fill the row on Desktop/Wide (canvas: FILL width, Bouton HUG). On Mobile/Tablette the canvas draws it HUG-height, centered by the root — but `grow` has no per-mode channel (layoutByProp carries direction/justify/align only), so in a column the code surface stretches it vertically: THIRD named code-only fact, the Odoo projection resets flex to 0 0 auto under the desktop breakpoint.

Accroche.description: Rides the responsive text style H1: size 32/32/40/54 and line-height 40/40/50/68 by viewport mode come from typography.h1.* (tokens/modes/viewport.*), weight SemiBold. `white-space: pre-line` renders the rich prop's line break.

Bouton.description: CTA. TWO named deviations from the canvas, both because the schema has no channel for them on a nested instance (stylesWhen and layoutByProp are refused on component parts — the child contract owns its styling): (1) on Mobile/Tablette the canvas pins the CTA ABSOLUTE to the bottom edge, full width inside the horizontal padding (bottom 64, inset 24 / 48) — here it stays in the flow under the title (gap 32); the Odoo projection applies the pin under the desktop breakpoint as a code-only fact. (2) iconRight is TRUE on Desktop/Wide only on the canvas; fixed TRUE here, the Odoo projection hides the glyph under the desktop breakpoint. Both are acknowledged in the pilot journal (specs/tiny/pilote-odoo-hero-video.md) and are the two schema gaps the Odoo wave must decide on.
